name: Pounded bitter eggplant
summary: Raw bitter eggplant pounded with salt, chili, and herbs, eaten with a lot of rice. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: The Dak Lak provincial portal, 18 Feb 2019, says Êđê cooks also eat bitter eggplant raw, pounded.
howToEat: Pound the fruit and add salt, chili, MSG, lá é, and the scallion-like leaves and bulbs. The portal calls it very hot and says it goes with a lot of rice. Bao Dak Lak on 26 Jul 2023 names cà đắng giã muối ớt among the famous plates, and says a tasting on Đường sách cà phê served cà đắng giã. A price is Check on arrival.
